definitions.explanation: A regular fee paid for the management and maintenance of shared facilities, especially in condominiums and rental properties.

examples.japanese: {管理費|かんりひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{1万円|いちまんえん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The management fee is 10,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{管理費|かんりひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: There's a management fee on top of the rent.

examples.japanese: {管理費|かんりひ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{共用|きょうよう}→共用：21529_kyouyou⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Common areas are cleaned using the management fee.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (management) + ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (expense, fee)

WHAT IT COVERS:
- ⟦{共用|きょうよう}→共用：21529_kyouyou⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧ (cleaning of common areas)
- ⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧⟦{維持|いじ}→維持：01624_iji⟧ (elevator maintenance)
- ⟦{防犯|ぼうはん}→防犯：08192_bouhan⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧ (security cameras)
- ⟦{管理人|かんりにん}→管理人：03047_kanrinin⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧ (building manager costs)
- ⟦{共用|きょうよう}→共用：21529_kyouyou⟧⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦{代|だい}→代：28331_dai⟧ (common area electricity)

RELATED FEES:
- ⟦{共益費|きょうえきひ}→共益費：06576_kyouekihi⟧ (common expense fee - similar meaning)
- ⟦{修繕|しゅうぜん}→修繕：06569_shuuzen⟧⟦{積立金|つみたてきん}→積立金：28915_tsumitatekin⟧ (repair reserve fund - for condos)
- ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦{代|だい}→代：28331_dai⟧ (parking fee)

RENTAL LISTINGS:
In Japanese property listings, you'll often see:
- ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧ ¥80,000 + {管理費|かんりひ} ¥5,000
- Or written as: {管理費|かんりひ}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧ (management fee included)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {管理費|かんりひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay the management fee)
- {管理費|かんりひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧ (management fee is high/low)
- {管理費|かんりひ}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧ (including management fee)
- ⟦{月額|げつがく}→月額：09739_getsugaku⟧{管理費|かんりひ} (monthly management fee)
